title: Carbon-Aware Electric Vehicle Routing Problem with Decision-Focused Learning
summary: Decision-focused learning trained a grid-carbon predictor against route cost. On realistic synthetic German EV-routing instances built from road, charging, weather and electricity data, the resulting routes had 2.30% lower average realized cost than forecast-focused learning and won on 75.5% of instances despite larger pointwise forecast error; this is a simulation result, not deployment evidence.
